enunciado: Two words are anagrams if they have the same letters with the same frequency. Use an array of 26 counters to decide whether these are anagrams: ("roma", "amor"), ("listen", "silent") and ("casa", "cosa").
objetivos: Solve in O(n) a problem that seems to need sorting
pistas: Add 1 for each letter of the first word and subtract 1 for each letter of the second.
They are anagrams if all counters end at 0.
If the lengths differ, you already know the answer.
